events.title: Next Stop Maryland
events.description: This 2 hour event is geared toward newly admitted students. You'll hear from the Office of Undergraduate Admissions and the Department of Resident Life about your next steps to becoming #AlwaysATerp! Students will also receive a tour and get a glimpse into what it's like living on campus. Registration required.

image.alt: Image of campus sign

events.title: EDUC Information Session & Tour
colleges: College of Education (EDUC)
events.description: The College of Education invites prospective students to to join us for an information academic information session and building tour! This event offers an excellent opportunity to learn more about our programs, admissions process, and student resources. During the session, you will hear from faculty and staff, who will provide insight into the academic experience, career opportunities, and support available to students.

image.alt: Students walking through the Edward St. John Learning Teaching Center.

events.title: ARHU School of Music Tours
colleges: College of Arts and Humanities (ARHU)
events.description: We invite you to sign up for a student-led tour of the School of Music! Students will have the opportunity to tour the Clarice Smith Performing Arts Center and ask questions about how the School of Music can be part of their UMD education. Advance registration (48 hours) is required.

image.alt: Students walking through the Edward St. John Learning Teaching Center.

events.title: Scholars Information Session
events.description: For our invited students and families unable to make one UMD's Admitted Student Open Houses, College Park Scholars is offering in-person informational sessions on select days this spring. You'll get a chance to meet our staff, talk to our student ambassadors and see the Cambridge Community in person.

image.alt: Students walking through the Edward St. John Learning Teaching Center.

events.title: Engineering Facilities Tour
colleges: A. James Clark School of Engineering (ENGR)
events.description: Interested in attending an in-person tour of a few of our engineering facilities? All tours will run approximately for an hour. We cannot guarantee that a specific departmental lab will be available on the day of your tour. Additionally, attending a virtual information session before participating in an in-person engineering facilities tour is highly encouraged. Due to capacity restrictions of the labs, we ask that you adhere to the visitor limit of two persons per family (i.e. student plus one additional guest).

events.title: SPH Virtual Information Session
colleges: School of Public Health (SPH)
events.description: The School of Public Health invites prospective students to join us for a virtual information session to learn more about how you can become a public health professional promoting health, preventing disease and prolonging active, high-quality lives. Staff and current students will present on our undergraduate degree programs (Family Health, Global Health, Kinesiology, Public Health Practice, and Public Health Science), opportunities beyond the classroom, and life as a public health Terp. We will have a short presentation and answer any questions you may have. Registration is required.

events.title: CMNS Virtual Information Session
colleges: College of Computer, Mathematical, and Natural Sciences (CMNS)
events.description: Are you a high school junior, senior, or transfer student interested in College of Computer, Mathematical, and Natural Sciences (CMNS) majors in Artificial Intelligence, Astronomy, Atmospheric & Oceanic Science, Biochemistry, Biological Sciences, Chemistry, Computer Science, Geology, Immersive Media Design: Computing, Mathematics, Neuroscience, or Physics at University of Maryland (UMD)? Want to hear about how UMD helps students interested in the health professions? Sign up for this virtual session to be held on Zoom on Wednesday, September 9, 2026 from 5:30-6:45 p.m. EST to learn about all that CMNS has to offer.

events.title: BMGT Information Session: Smith Friday
colleges: Robert H. Smith School of Business (BMGT)
events.description:
Are you a high school student starting to think about college? Are you thinking business might be the right degree for you? If so, register today for our Smith Friday to learn more about the Robert H. Smith School of Business at the University of Maryland, College Park.

During each Smith Friday you, and your family, will have the opportunity to meet with current faculty, staff, and students, participate in a college information session and specific prospective student and family Q&A sessions, and tour the home of the Smith School, Van Munching Hall.
